sub_sector.value: automotive paint protection film and window tint; ceramic coatings

manufacturing_type.detail: Films and coatings sourced from third-party manufacturers; XPEL brands, designs and distributes; installers apply product.

production_model.detail: Standard film rolls and pre-cut pattern kits sold from inventory through distribution to installers.

product_complexity.detail: Self-healing, hydrophobic, UV and heat-rejecting protective films and coatings.

production_role.detail: Supplies films and coatings to installers, dealers and OEM partners who apply them to vehicles.

end_market_exposure.detail: Vehicles mainly; also boats, homes and offices; sold through dealers and installers.

notes: Manufacturing is largely done by third-party suppliers (film produced by contract partners); inferred from company knowledge.
